description: A model reply with a known, machine-checkable shape (usually JSON matching a schema) instead of free text.
A request option that makes the output syntactically valid JSON. It does not guarantee the fields or types you expect.
The provider restricts generation to tokens that keep the output valid against a JSON Schema. Refusals and truncation can still break the shape.
Checking the parsed reply against a schema (Zod, Pydantic) in your code and using the validated, typed value.
Fixing mechanical, meaning-preserving defects without a model call: surrounding prose, code fences, trailing commas, quote style.
Sending the bad reply back with the specific validation error so the model can correct it. Bounded by a maximum number of attempts.
Zod 4 helper that turns a validation error into readable lines, each naming the path of the invalid field.
